description: Returns today's public U.S. mortgage-rate context from Market Eyes Live: the 10-year Treasury yield and its direction, mortgage-backed securities (MBS) momentum, the overall rate environment (falling, stable or rising), and a short explanation of what moves mortgage rates. Use this when the user asks what is driving U.S. mortgage rates or which way the rate environment is moving, for example 'what is driving mortgage rates this week' or 'are mortgage rates rising or falling'. Do not use for a specific lender's quoted rate, APR or fee comparisons, loan qualification, a personal lock decision, or anything outside the United States. Limitations: a daily read built from public market data; it describes conditions and does not forecast any individual's rate. Public market data and general education, not financial advice; this tool is read-only.
name: get_mortgage_rate_context

outputSchema.description: today's public mortgage-rate context; omitted only if the live feed is momentarily unavailable, which returns a text message instead

title: Get mortgage rate context
